fields.name: marketplace
fields.description: Amazon site code: us, gb, de, fr, in, ca, jp, es, it, mx, ae, au, br, sa

fields.name: queryMode
fields.description: Query mode. 1: single condition query (default); 2: multi-condition combined query (AND relationship)

fields.name: queryType
fields.description: Query type (1-16), only effective when queryMode=1. See the complete Query Types description in API.md

fields.name: queryValue
fields.description: Query condition value, format varies by queryMode and queryType. See the format description for each queryType in API.md

fields.name: page
fields.description: Page number, default 1. Max 100 products per page

fields.name: queryMonth
fields.description: Historical month lookback, format yyyy-MM. When not specified, queries real-time data
